name: Portability Validation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # 02:00 UTC daily
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'qumun/**'
      - 'main.go'
      - 'Makefile'

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build & Test on ${{ matrix.kernel_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        kernel_version: ['6.12.2', '6.13', '6.14', '6.15', '6.16', '6.17']
      fail-fast: false
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential clang llvm libelf-dev libbpf-dev

      - name: Download kernel headers ${{ matrix.kernel_version }}
        run: |
          KVER=${{ matrix.kernel_version }}
          wget -q https://cdn.kernel.org/pub/linux/kernel/v6.x/linux-${KVER}.tar.xz
          tar -xf linux-${KVER}.tar.xz
          sudo mv linux-${KVER} /usr/src/linux-${KVER}
          echo "KERNEL_HEADERS=/usr/src/linux-${KVER}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Install Go dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Build
        env:
          KERNEL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.kernel_version }}
        run: |
          make clean
          make

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          KERNEL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.kernel_version }}
        run: |
          make test || true
